property_name: 89.9% equity interests in four German logistics and industrial properties
counterparty: Fraser's Property Investments (Europe) BV and FPE Investments RE11 B.V.
note: Note 32 discloses acquisition of 89.9% equity interests in four property holding companies holding four German L&I properties, accounted for as acquisition of assets. Cash paid S$174.390m; investment properties acquired S$188.293m; acquisition costs S$1.820m; net cash outflow S$174.787m. Portfolio Statement identifies the four 27 March 2024 assets as Billbrookdeich 167, Hamburg; Werner-Von-Siemens-Straße 44, Saarwellingen; Hans-Fleißner Straße 46-48, Egelsbach; and Thomas-Dachser-Straße 3, Überherrn.

Forward-funded freehold logistics development near Maastricht Airport acquired/entered in FY2024; Portfolio Statement shows acquisition date 17 November 2023 and S$22.036m carrying amount as investment property under development. Operational review says project was ongoing at 30 September 2024 and completed after year-end in October 2024; no discrete purchase consideration was disclosed in the annual report.

counterparty: unrelated third party of the Group
note: Subsequent event disclosed in FY2024 annual report: sale and purchase agreement entered 17 October 2024 to acquire 2 Tuas South Link 1 for S$140.3m; acquisition completed 5 November 2024. Included as clearly disclosed subsequent property transaction.

counterparty: existing minority shareholders of the property holding companies
note: Subsequent event disclosed in FY2024 annual report: subsidiaries entered share purchase agreements with existing minority shareholders to reduce effective interest in each of 28 German properties to 89.9% for sale consideration of €23.3m (approximately S$33.3m). No per-property carrying value or gain disclosed in FY2024.
